final_text:
Fictional Customer 010 had the highest sales excluding tax from 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28, at 3,275.27.

**Source:** product DAILY_INVOICED_SALES, version 202, object `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0202`. The release was checked against its content hash and covers 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03, so all of February is included.

**Top 3 customers, ranked by computed invoiced sales excluding tax (invoice price minus tax; no currency in the data)**

| Rank | Customer | Customer ID | Sales Excl. Tax | Invoice Lines | Distinct Items | Active Days | First Invoice | Last Invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fictional Customer 010 | 10 | 3,275.27 | 10 | 9 | 4 | 2026-02-03 | 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | Fictional Customer 018 | 18 | 2,787.78 | 14 | 10 | 5 | 2026-02-04 | 2026-02-26 |
| 3 | Fictional Customer 008 | 8 | 2,600.14 | 10 | 8 | 4 | 2026-02-07 | 2026-02-20 |

- Customer 010 ranks first even though it has fewer invoice lines than Customer 018 (10 vs. 14).
- Customer 018 bought on the most days and the widest range of items.

**Limits of this data:** the ranking is based only on computed invoiced sales. The product has no data on marketing consent, campaign response, margin or campaign effect. So this list can't show whether a customer may be contacted, whether a campaign made a difference, or how profitable a customer is. Returns and discounts aren't included either, and days with no sales aren't filled in as zero.
